clean_task.detail: An independently authored accumulator task passed exact differential checks, UBSan bounds/object-size checks, and four alternating warm benchmark replays above the 1.05 speedup gate; no imported attachment executed.

provider_portability.detail: Provider independence was established by withdrawing the incumbent ari.provider.coding and re-offering the identical capability contracts under the reserved stand-in identity ari.provider.synthetic-substitute. All 4 capabilities the incumbent had won rebound, deterministically, and none stayed bound to the incumbent. No second implementation was executed, so this is not cross-Provider portability: it shows only that the requirement set names capabilities rather than a Provider. The report is stored beside this file as evidence/intel_performance_patterns.abstraction.json.
